title: Ward 4
time: 10:20 the morning after the crash (3.1's card lands here); one day, no sleep in this scene
player_goal: Wake up in a government ward with your wrist in a cast; find out where you are and who is in the next bed.
design_goal: Curiosity after the shock (Act 3's quiet middle): you cannot leave, you can barely carry anything, and the ward is full of small wrong things — a nurse you've met before, a glass door at the end with the lights off behind it, a TV that keeps saying 'viral'. Ravi, concussed, talks in loops, and the loop keeps coming back to one sentence: 'Appa called. I answered.' That sentence is the door into 3.3, the flashback.

cast.role: The nurse from the 335-E bus (1.5), on day shift. Her badge reads SISTER LALITHA · HEBBAL GENERAL. If you talked on the bus (nurse_heard): 'You. The Cubbon bus. You let me sleep.' Else: 'You've got a face I've seen.' Then: 'Stay this side of the red line. That door is isolation. Nobody goes in, nobody asks.' She is kind, quick, and does not answer questions about the ward at the end.

In the next bed, head bandaged, concussed. He doesn't remember the junction. He talks in loops — the stipend 'still processing', his sister's wedding, 'they'll dock me for the bike'. If ravi_supported: 'You came at 1 AM. Nobody comes at 1 AM.' If ravi_left: he doesn't mention that night at all. Every loop ends nearer one sentence: 'Appa called. That night. I answered. You're supposed to change gloves first.' Then he stops.

beats.what: 3.1's card lands here: its last panel 'HEBBAL GENERAL · WARD 4 · 10:20 — Left wrist: fractured. A cast, six weeks.' and the ward fades in, you beside your bed. You walk at 70% and cannot run. The phone: Amma ('Where are you? … Call me.' — one bar), Sameer (his bike / your scooter), Divya ('HR says take the week. Don't worry about AMR-07. Really.').

Sister Lalitha at her desk: the bus callback only if nurse_heard; the red line; 'that door is isolation'. Two answers, both end the conversation. The tray on your locker: two cold idlis, food +30, once.

The taped glass doors at the far end: dark behind the newspaper, a slow tapping, it stops when you step back (stress +3). Optional: the ward TV ticker (ward_tv_seen). The ward door: a ward boy outside — 'Not discharged. Sister will tell you when.'

Ravi in the next bed, three visits: (1) 'Do I know you?' — or 'You came at one in the morning' (ravi_supported) / a blank 'Hi.' (ravi_left) — the bike, the stipend, 'Appa called. That night. I —' asleep; (2) Akka's wedding loan, the samples were his, 'you change gloves first'; (3) 'Appa called. That night. In the corridor. I answered.' The ward stays playable; 3.3 starts from this line when it is built.

exits.note: no way out: the door is a conversation with the ward boy ('Not discharged'); 3.5 Discharge opens it
